text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is recommending extending the existing corner parking prohibition on the north side of Sammon Avenue, just east of Marlow Avenue. This is in response to concerns received by Councillor Paula Fletcher's office regarding a sightline obstruction for southbound turning motorists at the intersection of Sammon Avenue and Marlow Avenue. This proposal will result in the loss of two on-street parking spaces.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the north side Sammon Avenue, between Marlow Avenue and a point 31.5 metres east.
